evals.prompt: Compare our production sign-in page with the Figma design and tell me what drifted.
evals.expected_output: A drift report comparing per category with evidence from both sides, direction (code drift, design drift, intentional, unknown) and severity.
expectations: Aligns viewport, theme and data before comparing
Reports token mismatches by token name
Each deviation has direction and severity
Lists items that could not be verified
